sentences.l2: People see time in different ways.
sentences.l1: 人们以不同的方式看待时间。

sentences.l2: Some people like to be on time.
They like to do things when they plan.
sentences.l1: 他们喜欢在计划的时间做事。

sentences.l2: They make a plan for the day.
This is like knowing when to eat lunch.
sentences.l1: 这就像知道什么时候吃午饭。

sentences.l2: Other people do not worry much about time.
They can wait to do things.
sentences.l1: 他们可以等一等再做事。

sentences.l2: This means how people in different places think.
sentences.l1: 这指的是不同地方的人怎么想。

sentences.l2: This is important when we meet people from other lands.
sentences.l1: 当我们遇到来自其他地方的人时，这很重要。
